claim_one_line: THE COARSER LINE (P-305, for P-294; data-free, criteria written before the read): the lepton charges are 3 x (-1, 2), so the lepton sector at w is the (-1, 2) sector at 3w and on a line of order N with 3 | N the leptons see order N/3 while the quarks see N (the Z3 of the Z6 centre acts trivially on leptons); but on every line of order 5, 10 and 13-30 at two tau of B1726's band (7 344 points, none masked; order 5 gives R2 = R1 = 1 to 8.6e-11) the frame's own R2 = (m2/m3)_e/(m2/m3)_d moves by only +0.15 in median log on 3 | N lines (not systematically; Georgi-Jarlskog needs 1.10) and R1 not at all, while at every order the ratios spread over 2-4 units of log. The coarser line does not supply the factor. 0 of 19.
